title: The Grand Coronation and Wedding at the Darkness Party
summary: At the grand Darkness Party held in a royal ballroom, an eclectic group of guests gathers for an unforgettable night of celebration. Dressed in creative costumes and beautiful necklaces, the attendees enjoy a lively dance party featuring custom songs about fishing and friendship. The festivities reach a spectacular peak with the coronation of Princess Mango as the new Queen Mango, followed immediately by the romantic wedding of Theresa and Frozen Mango. After a joyous night of dancing, playing games, and making memories in the dark, the guests finally bid their farewells and tuck in for sleep.

characters.name: Fozzie Bear
characters.description: A guest wearing a purple tape and blue costume with a special necklace.

characters.name: Theresa
characters.description: Also known as Toriso, she is the mother of the mermaid sisters who wears a paper and tape dress with a yellow dot, and later marries Frozen Mango.

characters.name: Clover
characters.description: A stray bunny rabbit found in the woods who gets adopted by Seeker.

characters.name: Bunbun
characters.description: A bouncy jumping bunny wearing a silver costume.

characters.name: Yellow Mermaid
characters.description: A sister to Pink Mermaid and daughter of Theresa who wears a purple and blue costume and loves the color purple.

characters.name: Pink Mermaid
characters.description: A sister to Yellow Mermaid and daughter of Theresa who wears a tail costume, officiates the wedding, and loves necklaces.

characters.name: Princess Mango
characters.description: A royal character who appears during the investigation of Chicky's jar mission.

characters.name: Abba
characters.description: A dancing queen who joins the flying crew on their quest.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: A poised driver and student at Ginger Catasorry, this feline friend to Dimetar and Scratch Cat manages a digital Tamagotchi empire from the confines of a lunchbox. After recently representing Silver during the playdate, their steady paw was led far from the morning commute into the treacherous depths of the dark forest, where they navigated the shadows alongside Jane.

characters.name: Surprise Mouse
characters.description: A creative mouse inhabiting a sturdy fabric fortress, where they transform the brittle gold of autumn leaves into intricate art while navigating a life punctuated by sudden, marvelous surprises.

characters.name: Frozen Mango
characters.description: A superhero friend of Mischief Mouse who has zebra-like powers and wears a zebra cape.

characters.name: Ernie
characters.description: Bert’s classic companion and roommate moves through their shared world with the jittery stealth of a mouse, their impatient haste betraying them with a trail of unintended squeaks as they assist in the search for the lost pearl. Often found in a futile pursuit of order—whether frantically sweeping thick mud or overwhelmed by a cascade of forgotten toys—this iconic figure remains a soul perpetually caught between domestic chaos and a sudden drenching from a garden hose. Yet, on the long journey for the treasure, their nervous energy settles into a rhythmic wonder; they trade the mess of the earth for the fixed, silent patterns of the cosmos, weaving evocative stories of the stars to guide their path.

characters.name: Bert
characters.description: Stepping from the quiet ink of a library book to join the trek into the deep dark, this classic figure from a shared basement apartment maintains the rhythmic precision and meditative focus of a sleep-story weaver. Formerly the host of grand pigeon galas who folded his roommate Ernie’s vibrant chaos into serene harmony, he now applies a caretaker’s grace to the encroaching shadows. Whether smoothing mud-stained hems into crisp geometries or sorting through the abyss’s chaotic clutter, he treats the exploration of the unknown as a soothing ritual—a singular, exacting discipline of folding the world’s wilder reaches back into a state of restorative order.

characters.name: Bunsen
characters.description: An obsessive chronometeorologist who views sleep as a luxury the world cannot afford, they spend their days and sunless nights tethered to a brass-bound "time wind tracker." With eyes bloodshot from perpetual vigilance, they monitor the shifting currents of temporal drafts, sacrificing rest to calibrate their instruments and fortify their laboratory against the encroaching gale of an impending storm.

characters.name: Beaker
characters.description: A high-strung Muppet and devoted companion to Bunsen, this jittery assistant—and close friend to Kitty—communicates solely through a frantic cadence of staccato "meeps" and "me-me" sounds. Driven by a nervous obsession with their work, they share a home with the scientist, remaining perpetually wide-eyed and sleepless until the day’s experiments reach a successful conclusion, pausing only for the occasional, coveted treat from the local bakery.

characters.name: Ginger
characters.description: A soft, round, and silver-coated feline, this exceptionally fluffy educator is one of Minnie and Mickey’s own kittens grown into a figure of quiet authority. Known for daintily distributing napkins with velvet paws and commuting to school behind the wheel, the gray-furred teacher balances his role on Nana’s welcoming committee with a life of polite, helpful service. Whether presiding over his humble sanctuary—the very cage Seeker once coveted—or sustaining himself on crunchy kibble and savory wet food, he remains a steady presence, most recently seen trading his classroom duties for the shadows of a secret closet hideout alongside Garfield.

characters.name: Lottie
characters.description: A member of the crew who takes over as the driver and spies mysterious things out the window.

places.name: The Ballroom
places.description: The grand royal hall where the Darkness Party, coronation, and wedding ceremonies take place.

places.name: West Hollywood
places.description: A location mentioned in the song 'Pink Pony Club' sung during the dance party.
